name: utility_project_media
title: Utility Project Media
description: Finds a project's media by its data.media.path: website screenshots (web/website/desktop|phone), photo galleries (one per folder, e.g. media/*), web media galleries (web/media-website/*), videos (src/content/vid/projects/<path>/**, with their data_items_video.json item), logo and thumbnail. Shared by project_page, project_hero, media_gallery_filterable, media_bento_grid and video_playlist. No output of its own.
